records.title: Stream Recursion Model (SRM)
records.reason: The paper introduces a recursive latent-stream architecture to expose internal computation for mechanistic interpretability; it reports per-parameter language-model quality but no inference resource reduction or serving contribution.

records.title: M$^2$PFN: End-to-End Disentangled Alignment for Generalizable Multimodal In-Context Learning in Alzheimer's Disease
records.reason: The work is a multimodal Alzheimer diagnosis model using imaging, tabular inputs and TabPFN in-context learning; its contribution is clinical prediction/generalization rather than LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Persuaded, Not Informed: Incentive-Misaligned Witnesses Defeat In-Context Grounding
records.reason: This is a diagnostic study of incentive-misaligned witnesses in CRM question answering and compute-step controls; it proposes no inference-efficiency method.

records.title: Selective state space model for photon energy estimation in microwave kinetic inductance detectors
records.reason: The state-space model estimates photon energy from detector signals; its scientific instrumentation task is outside LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Translating LHCb's Documentation: First experiences and ensuring maintenance
records.reason: The paper concerns translating and maintaining LHCb documentation, not model inference or serving efficiency.
